name: Python 3
updateContentCommand: /bin/sh -c 'wget https://repo.anaconda.com/miniconda/Miniconda3-latest-Linux-x86_64.sh -O /tmp/miniconda.sh && bash /tmp/miniconda.sh -b -p $HOME/miniconda && $HOME/miniconda/bin/conda init bash && source $HOME/.bashrc && $HOME/miniconda/bin/conda env create -f environment.yml || echo "⚠️ Failed to create Conda environment!"'
postCreateCommand: /bin/sh -c 'source $HOME/.bashrc && $HOME/miniconda/bin/conda env update -f environment.yml || echo "⚠️ Failed to update Conda environment!"'

postAttachCommand.server: /bin/sh -c 'mkdir -p ~/.streamlit && cp /workspaces/Wander_Builders-1/.streamlit/config.toml ~/.streamlit/config.toml && source $HOME/.bashrc && $HOME/miniconda/bin/conda run -n wander_env streamlit run app.py'
